title: 第25章 实力暴增第26章 苏琳遇王同
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
双重打击。
虽然每次发动都需要消耗精神力。
但他全属性同步增长。
现在精神属性高达近700点。
底蕴雄厚，根本不惧这点消耗。
这么想着，林默果断选择了这个技能。
随着他做出选择，手中那枚墨色技能精髓的光芒彻底黯淡下去。
最终化为一股精纯的能量完全融入他的体内。
紧接着，一股远比之前吸收风狼王精髓时更加磅礴汹涌的力量洪流在他体内炸开！
仿佛某种一直禁锢着他的枷锁被瞬间冲垮！
【检测到您已吸收符合标准的20级技能精髓！】
【等级提升至11级！】
【全属性提升200点！】
【获得自由属性点：200点！】
脑海中响起的提示音让林默精神大振！
之前吸收10级风狼王的精髓，只提升了50点全属性和50点自由属性点。
而这20级的精髓，带来的提升足足是前者的四倍！
这巨大的差距，让他更加直观地感受到了等级突破后带来的质变。
一股前所未有的强大力量感充斥全身，感官变得更加敏锐，思维也愈发清晰。
【肉体：862】

【敏捷：952】
【精神：862】
【自由属性点：250】
【技能：镜像、双重打击】
他心念一动，将肉体和精神属性分别加了90点。
三项属性追平，同时达到了952点。
而自由属性点还剩下70，留着关键时刻使用。
然而，这还没完！
就在他沉浸在升级喜悦中时。
手中一直握着的黑剑，突然传来一阵奇异的悸动！
一股冰冷的能量波动从剑身内部苏醒，顺着剑柄涌入他的手臂。
林默心中一凛，立刻低头看去：“怎么回事？难道是副作用？”
一直在一旁与暗墨蛛王闲聊的殷血也察觉到了异常。
瞬间飞了过来，绕着黑剑仔细感应。
片刻后，她猛地一拍自己的小脑袋，脸上露出恍然大悟的表情：
“嘿呀！我怎么把这么重要的事给忘了！”
她兴奋地对着林默说道。
“这把魔武，它跟教会那些光明圣装一样，是会随着使用者的成长而一同进化成长的！你突破了10级的瓶颈，它也解锁了新的能力！”
content_en:
A double whammy.
Although each activation requires the consumption of mental energy.
But all his attributes increase simultaneously.
Now the mental attributes are as high as nearly 700 points.
He has a strong foundation and is not afraid of this consumption at all.
With this thought in mind, Lin Mo decisively chose this skill.
As he made his choice, the light of the ink-colored skill essence in his hand completely dimmed.
Eventually it turned into a pure energy and completely integrated into his body.
Immediately afterwards, a torrent of power that was far more majestic and turbulent than when he absorbed the essence of the Wind Wolf King exploded in his body!
It was as if some kind of shackles that had been imprisoning him were instantly broken!
[It has been detected that you have absorbed the essence of level 20 skills that meet the standards! 】
[Level increased to level 11! 】
[All attributes increased by 200 points! 】
[Get free attribute points: 200 points! 】
The reminder sound in his mind cheered up Lin Mo!
Previously, after absorbing the essence of the Level 10 Wind Wolf King, it only increased 50 points of all attributes and 50 points of free attributes.
And the improvement brought by this level 20 essence is four times that of the former!
This huge gap allowed him to more intuitively feel the qualitative changes brought about by the level breakthrough.
An unprecedented sense of powerful power filled his body, his senses became sharper, and his thinking became clearer.
【Body: 862】
[Agility: 952]
【Spirit: 862】
[Free attribute points: 250]
[Skills: Mirror Image, Double Strike]
With a thought, he increased the physical and mental attributes by 90 points each.
The three attributes were tied, reaching 952 points at the same time.
There are still 70 free attribute points left, which can be used at critical moments.
However, this is not over yet!
Just when he was immersed in the joy of upgrading.
The black sword he had been holding in his hand suddenly felt a strange throbbing!
A wave of cold energy awakened from inside the sword body and poured into his arm along the hilt.
Lin Mo was shocked and immediately looked down: "What's going on? Is it a side effect?"
Yin Xue, who had been chatting with the Dark Black Spider King, also noticed something unusual.
He flew over instantly and circled the black sword to sense it carefully.
After a moment, she slapped her little head suddenly, with a look of realization on her face:
"Hey! How could I forget such an important thing!"
She said excitedly to Lin Mo.
"This magic weapon, like those bright holy clothes of the church, will evolve and grow with the growth of the user! You have broken through the bottleneck of level 10, and it has also unlocked new abilities!"
